Cricket legend Garry Sobers dies at 89

Sir Garfield Sobers, a celebrated West Indies all-rounder widely regarded as one of cricket's greatest players, has died at the age of 89. Sobers was known for his exceptional skills with both bat and ball, redefining the sport during his career. His passing has prompted tributes from the global cricket community, remembering his significant contributions and impact.
